name: Letter to Stormpike
summary: Loremaster Dibbs in Southshore holds a cleverly encrypted letter, and he knows someone in Ironforge who might decrypt it. He sends you with the letter to Prospector Stormpike, in the Library of the Hall of Explorers.

sections.title: A Colleague in Ironforge
sections.body: Prospector Stormpike is to be found in the Library, in the Hall of Explorers in Ironforge. Dibbs wants you to tell Stormpike that he sent you, and to show the letter. Dibbs reckons that if anyone north of Blackrock Spire can read it, Stormpike is the one.

sections.title: Stormpike's Welcome
sections.body: Stormpike asks how the old bookworm is doing when he hears Dibbs sent you. Then he declares that encryption is a specialty of his and begins to look the letter over.

faq.q: Who sends you to Ironforge with the letter?
faq.answer: Loremaster Dibbs in Southshore sends you, hoping a colleague in Ironforge can decrypt the letter.
Prospector Stormpike is in the Library inside the Hall of Explorers in Ironforge.

faq.q: Why does Dibbs believe Stormpike can read the letter?
faq.answer: Dibbs says that if anyone north of Blackrock Spire can read it, it is Stormpike.
